text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Strawberry au lait, or carrot au 
lait...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Carrot au Lait it is!
(Beep. Thud—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're as fond of sweets as ever, aren't 
you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove! What brings you all the 
way out to the Miho Dorm? A delivery from 
the President?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As soon as she gets back from her 
outing, I'll deliver it to the President's 
office. ......I think I'll make it black.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You still seem busy with student council 
work lately. You're barely even in the 
classroom during breaks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you wish for things to 
go smoothly, trouble never ceases to 
arise. So in a way, it's just business as 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, the joint class 
mixer with the junior high division is 
just around the corner. Is everything okay 
with your group?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We left Taishin to Ticket-zo, and 
Hayahide said she'd step in to back them 
up if anything comes up.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe can be a bit blunt, but what she's 
saying isn't wrong, so—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If I set a nice, cheerful mood, I'm sure 
the juniors will be happy to have heard a 
good story!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see, I'm glad to hear things will run 
smoothly. The preparations for my group 
are going well too, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've got the prank-loving Windy around, 
after all. I'll have to keep a strict eye 
on her to make sure she doesn't go biting 
the juniors under any circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, if your mouth feels lonely, I'll go 
share some gum with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If the underclassmen start copying you two 
and chewing gum becomes a fad on campus, 
that might be an issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's certainly a reasonable way to 
handle it. If anything unexpected happens, 
I'll call on you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If anything comes up, I'll count on 
you too, Air Groove. Let's help each other 
out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No... I just thought perhaps I was 
getting a bit ahead of myself. Let's 
support each other, together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ――Pardon me. Excuse the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President...! I told you I would bring it 
to your room...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You've already been running all over the 
place for me. The least I can do is go 
pick up the luggage myself."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful for your concern... 
Here is the item entrusted to me by the 
Chairwoman. ...Well then, I shall take my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Help each other out, huh...? Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You're quite good at helping her relax. I 
suppose it's possible because you treat 
each other as equals."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ? Aren't classmates all on equal footing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even with those her own age, Air Groove 
can't help but step in and take care of 
them. Someone who can talk to her on equal 
footing is truly rare.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“I see... 'Equals'... If you see me that 
way, I'm honored. Because...!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Fighting fiercely and pushing each other 
higher— that's only possible because 
you're equals. Isn't that the most 
'special' thing there is!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What a positive and enterprising 
mindset. Please, cherish that "special" 
feeling.

The next day, after finishing up 
preparations for training, Bubble Gum 
Fellow suddenly asked a question.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, are Trainer and I on equal footing?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean anything weird by it! I was 
just wondering how things actually are!

She doesn't seem to be asking out of 
distress. I decide to tell her frankly 
what I think.
choice_data_list: I don't think we're on equal footing.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that in terms of aiming for 
victory in races, we are equals. As her 
Trainer, I make sure not to hold back out 
of unnecessary reserve.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see! I don't think there's any 
need to hold back either. Athletic life is 
something we tackle side by side, 
together!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for answering. Let's keep 
doing our best together as equals!

I'm not sure of his true intentions, but 
Bubble Gum Fellow looks genuinely happy. 
It's great to see that he trusts me!

"The runner and the supporter have 
different roles and aren't equals. I 
expressed my determination as a Trainer to 
work even harder than Bubble Gum Fellow."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're as dependable as always!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, don't you go underestimating me. 
I'm giving it my all to surpass you too, 
Trainer!”

Surpassing Bubble Gum Fellow is no easy 
feat. I brace myself, knowing I must 
challenge her with even stronger resolve!
